name: Panta HVI Freightliner Top 50 DTC Reference
source: Heavy Vehicle Inspection & Maintenance - Freightliner Top 50 DTC Codes & Fixes
usage_note: Source-derived supplemental troubleshooting reference. Preserve exact SPN/FMI and system context. Suggested fixes are diagnostic starting points, not proof a named component failed; prefer OEM Detroit/Freightliner procedures when available.

documents.title: Freightliner critical DTC triage
documents.summary: HVI lists critical/high-priority examples involving DEF quality, CAN/J1939 communication, SCR NOx conversion, DPF soot load, high coolant temperature, engine-protection derate, low intake-manifold pressure, low fuel-rail pressure, NOx calibration and J1939 network communication. Use the exact SPN/FMI and diagnose root cause before parts replacement.

documents.title: Freightliner engine fuel and EGR common DTCs
documents.summary: HVI engine examples include low fuel-delivery pressure, high fuel temperature, fuel-pump-relay open circuit, EGR position error and cylinder-1 injector open circuit. Source troubleshooting suggestions include checking filters/lift-pump operation, fuel cooling/return flow, relay/wiring, EGR actuator/valve condition and injector circuit resistance/connectors.

documents.title: Freightliner air boost turbo and EGR flow DTCs
documents.summary: HVI air/boost examples cover boost-pressure sensor high, intake-air pressure high, turbo speed low, intake-manifold temperature high and low EGR mass flow. Suggested checks include sensor circuits, turbo/VGT operation, charge-air-cooler leaks/efficiency, exhaust restriction and EGR cooler/differential-pressure conditions.

documents.title: Freightliner DT12 transmission common DTCs
documents.summary: HVI lists DT12 examples involving clutch actuator response, gear-selector position, calibration/adaptation, TCU communication, transmission-oil temperature, input/output speed sensors, transmission CAN, clutch wear and PTO engagement. Diagnose air supply, solenoids, sensors/tone rings, TCU power/ground/CAN, oil/cooling and interlocks as applicable.

documents.title: Freightliner electrical body and comfort DTCs
documents.summary: HVI electrical/body examples include high/low battery voltage, alternator-not-charging, headlamp and turn-signal circuits, A/C compressor circuit, blower-motor fault and cabin-temperature sensor error. Use these as system-level starting points and verify the reporting controller because SPNs can mean different things in different controller contexts.

documents.title: Freightliner ABS ESC and safety DTCs
documents.summary: HVI safety examples cover ABS system failure, steering-angle calibration, right-front and left-rear wheel-speed faults, low brake pressure, collision-mitigation radar, yaw-rate communication, brake-switch signal, ABS warning-lamp faults and trailer-ABS communication. Brake-pressure and major ABS failures are treated as immediate safety concerns.

documents.title: Freightliner DTC response priority guidance
documents.summary: HVI organizes response into stop-immediately conditions for imminent engine/safety risk, service-ASAP for DEF/DPF/derate/sensor issues, scheduled service for noncritical comfort/secondary systems, and monitoring for intermittent/historical/adaptation information. It advises fixing the underlying condition rather than merely clearing a returning code and prioritizing active faults while reviewing inactive faults for patterns.

documents.title: HVI Freightliner DTC grounding rule
documents.summary: Treat HVI quick fixes as supplemental troubleshooting ideas. Never convert a quick-fix suggestion directly into a parts recommendation. Cross-check the exact SPN/FMI, reporting ECU, truck configuration and engine/transmission generation against OEM material already in Panta when available.
